CageWingTileDispY.name: Unused. Draw four wing tile columns
summary: Unreferenced (reached only from unreachable code at $02CC05). Draws 4 columns of two 8x8 tiles at X offsets $00/$30/$60/$90 from the sprite,
alternating tile numbers every 8 frames of [$1570]. The first row of this section is the Y offset table ($F8,$00,$F8,$00).
$02CD2D (end of section): long-call wrapper for the Palace Switch routine at $02CD59; called from bank 1.

s02CD35.name: Table: Palace Switch tile layout
summary: Per-tile X offset, Y offset, tile number, properties for the 8 tiles, then the palette bits per switch color ([$191E]).

s02CD59.name: Palace Switch: generate block and draw
summary: Main routine of the Palace Switch sprite (called via CODE_02CD2D). When timer [$1540] equals $5E it generates block $1B above the switch.
Then runs the invisible block routine (so Mario can stand on it) and draws 8 tiles; the first four get the switch color palette from [$191E].

PeaBouncerMain.name: Wall springboard main
summary: Sprite main routine for the wall springboard (sprites $6B/$6C, called from bank 1). Draws it, then (if sprites are not locked)
runs the A-button bounce window ([$1534]) and the state machine in [$1528]: 0 idle, 1 compressing, 2 springing back and oscillating.
[$C2] = signed compression amount, [$151C] = target amplitude.

s02CDFF.name: Table: wall springboard bounce speeds
summary: First row: Mario Y speed for a boosted bounce (A pressed in time), indexed by [$151C]. Second row: normal bounce speed, indexed by [$C2].

s02CE0F.name: Wall springboard state routines
summary: $02CE0F: state 1 (compress): [$C2] counts up to [$151C], then holds 8 frames and switches to state 2.
$02CE3A: state 2: oscillates [$C2] between +/-[$151C] in steps of 4, reducing the amplitude every 4 frames until it reaches 0 (back to state 0).
$02CE8C: unreachable wrapper for the graphics routine.

s02CE90.name: Table: wall springboard piece X offsets

s02CEB8.name: Table: wall springboard piece Y offsets

s02CEE0.name: Wall springboard: draw and Mario contact
summary: $02CEE0: draws 5 coil pieces (tile $3D). Offsets come from the two tables indexed by |[$C2]| * 5 + piece; mirrored for the other wall and for negative compression.
$02CF52: per-piece contact check. If Mario is falling onto the piece, he is placed on top of it, X speed is cleared and the spring starts compressing,
or (if already compressed and [$1540] = 1) the bounce speed is applied and the [$1534] boost window opens.

SubOffscreen3Bnk2.name: Off-screen check, entry 3 (bank 2 copy)
summary: Same as the bank 1 SubOffscreen routines. Entry points set [$03] = 6, 4, 2, 0 which select the screen margin (and for 4, skip the bottom-of-level kill).

SubOffscreen0Bnk2.name: Off-screen check, entry 0 (bank 2 copy)
summary: Erases the sprite when it is far enough outside the screen, unless [$167A] bit 2 (process off screen) is set.
Parameters: X = sprite index; [$03] set by the entry point.

OffScrEraseSprBnk2.name: Erase sprite, allow level reload
summary: If the sprite status is 8 or more and it came from the level data, clears its load status so it can respawn; then erases it.

VerticalLevelBnk2.name: Off-screen check for vertical levels
summary: Same test as the horizontal version but on Y position, run only every other frame; erases the sprite when too far off screen.

IsSprOffScreenBnk2.name: Is sprite off screen?
summary: Returns: A non-zero (Z clear) if the sprite is off screen horizontally or vertically.

s02D0D0.name: Table: Yoshi mouth X offset
summary: Low and high bytes: facing right +$0014, facing left -$0004.

s02D0D4.name: Yoshi: eat berry from tile in front
summary: JSL entry $02D0D4 (from bank 1): if the swallow timer [$1564] is 0 and [$160E] bit 7 is set, reads the Map16 tile at Yoshi's mouth.
If it is a berry tile ($45-$47), stores the berry type in [$18D6], starts the swallow timer and snaps Mario's Y to a 16 pixel boundary.
The tile position is saved in [$18B0]-[$18B3] for SetTreeTile. $02D0EA is an unreachable layer 2 variant.

SetTreeTile.name: Replace berry with tree tile
summary: Generates block $04 (tree behind the berry) at the position saved by the berry check ([$18B0]-[$18B3]).

s02D210.name: Table: balloon/cloud speed deltas and limits

ControlSprCarried.name: Control P-balloon / Lakitu cloud with D-pad
summary: Called every few frames. Changes the sprite's X and Y speed from the Control Pad, then copies them to Mario.
Parameters: X = sprite index; data bank must be $02.

CscGoRight.name: Handle left pressed: compare with limit

CscUnderLimitX.name: Add speed delta for the direction

CscDecideY.name: Choose target Y speed
summary: Lakitu cloud: -16 / 0 / +16 for up / neutral / down. P-balloon: -16 up, -8 neutral, +8 down.

CscHandleY.name: Move Y speed toward target, copy to Mario

UpdateXPosNoGrvty.name: Update X position without gravity
summary: Adds $0C to X so UpdateYPosNoGrvty uses the X speed table, then restores X from [$15E9].
